{{Class_Template|number_of_champions = 8|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = [[Warrior]]|weakness = [[Tactician]]|image1 = File:Class Use Brawler.png}}'''Brawler''' is one of six Bot Classes. It has a Class Bonus against [[Warrior]], but is weak to [[Tactician]].

==Description==
''Brawler Bots are armored allies and furious foes that value strength at any cost.''

==Class Bonus==
*The low Critical Rate and high attack of [[Brawler]] Bots give them an advantage over [[Warrior]] Bots.
*Brawlers have a high Health rating.
*Brawlers love to dash to their opponents.
*All brawlers rely on melee attacks.
*Most Brawlers utilize Armor Buffs and [[Melee Buff]]s. These buffs, however, can be neutralized by Tacticians.
*Some Brawlers take advantage of damaging debuffs, like [[Bleed]].

==List of Brawler Bots==
*[[Grindor]]
*[[Motormaster]]
*[[Optimus Prime (MV1)]]
*[[Grimlock]]
*[[Optimus Primal]]
*[[Sharkticon]] Brawler
*[[Tantrum]]
*[[Thundercracker]]

{{Class_Template|number_of_champions = 10|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = [[Tech]]|weakness = [[Warrior]]|image1 = File:Class Use Scout.png}}'''Scout'''s are one of six Bot Classes in ''[[Transformers: Forged to Fight]]''. It has a Class Bonus against [[Tech]]s, but is weak to [[Warrior]]s.

==In-Game Description==
''Scout Bots quickly eliminate opponents with frequent Special Attacks and a high Critical Rate.''
*Frequent critical attacks and damaging debuffs from [[Scout]] Bots are effective against the high base attributes of [[Tech]] bots.
*Most Scouts have [[Evade]] abilities that help them automatically avoid attacks.
*Scouts have a high critical rate, but low Health rating.
*Scouts' abilities can neutralize Tech Bots' abilities like Power buffs and shields.

== Strategies ==
Scouts are speedy and critical in their movements and attacks. They love Critical Hits to the point a Commander can count them as fast as they can beat story Act 1. They also love Special Attacks, and their Evasion buffs mask their low health rating. They're also able to find a way around [[Tech]] bots' abilities like defensive shields and power gains, so expect the mighty [[Shockwave]] to tremble against Generations [[Bumblebee]] in a match-up. And as stated above, Scouts, like their [[Warrior|worst nightmares]], love Critical ''Hit''s, but never increase their critical ''damage''.

Scouts are somewhat annoying to fight due to their scouty slipperiness expected from the typical scout Bot, so while any other class type works, a Warrior can neutralize their evasion, making sure they're forged not to evade, but to be stuck without evasion.

==List of Scout Bots==
*[[Windblade]]
*[[Sideswipe]]
*[[Barricade]]
*[[Prowl]]
*[[Bumblebee]]
*[[Kickback]]
*[[Sharkticon]] Scout
*[[Cheetor]]
*[[Jazz]]
*[[S-1000]] (when obtained by the player)
*[[Slipstream]]

{{Class_Template|number_of_champions = 10|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = [[Scout]]|weakness = [[Brawler]]|image1 = File:Class Use Warrior.png}}'''Warrior'''s are one of the six Bot Classes in ''[[Transformers: Forged to Fight]]''. It has a Class Bonus against [[Scout]]s, but is weak to [[Brawler]]s.

==In-Game Description==
''Warrior Bots have deadly accuracy and love bleeding Energon from their opponents.''
*The tracking systems of [[Warrior]] Bots give them an advantage over the evasive [[Scout]] Bots.
*Most Warriors can inflict [[Bleed]] debuffs.
*Warriors' Buffs such as [[Precision]] can counter [[Evade]] abilities.

== Strategies ==
Almost all Warriors specialize in anti-evasion and Bleeds, though some may incorporate one or the other, or both. For example, [[Hot Rod]] never Bleeds but specializes in anti-evasion, [[Bludgeon]] specializes in Bleeds and [[Arcee]] specializes in both.

Warriors, much like the class they're meant to counter, the [[Scout]]s, like to score Critical Hits and may have buffs related to those. They are also [[Arcee|usu]][[Hot Rod|al]][[Hound|ly]] close-range, usually fighting with a melee weapon of some sort. However, this reliance on close-range attacks turns out to also be their downfall, as [[Brawler]]s have abilities that counter these kinds of attacks.

==List of Warrior Bots==
*[[Bludgeon]]
*[[Arcee]]
*[[Bonecrusher]]
*[[Drift]]
*[[Hot Rod]]
*[[Hound]]
*[[Sharkticon]] Warrior
*[[Scorponok]]
*[[Necrotronus]]
*[[Dirge]]
